title: drupilot detector catalog (config/catalog/<name>.json)
description: The common envelope of a detector catalog (hard breaks, the PHPUnit and SimpleTest maps, the Drush and library scans, D7 successors; each arrives with the milestone that uses it). Every entry carries an id, its source and verified; entry-specific fields are free. Only a verified entry that is never verified_as 'announced' may drive a hard gate.

catalog.description: The catalog's name: the file's basename.

blocking.description: Whether a hit is a hard break (needs verified and never announced).
